connected_findings: Known G4/shared unmasked source selection and rewriting weakness; the following requirements define faithful post-repair prose, not separate subjective style findings.

contract_inventory.existing_contract: Current regex captures first matching function in original text, including comments. NativeParameter borrows declaration/name/type and SourceParameter retains original trimmed declaration+role. Map/Gather/Stencil require return metadata, Scatter/Stream void-style headers.
contract_inventory.disposition: Connected pre-repair weakness; shared owner planned, not implemented
contract_inventory.required_wording: “Borrowed lexical view of one uniquely selected named source function. Comment-masked text preserves original UTF-8 byte offsets; spans identify original source. This is projection metadata, not whole WGSL parsing, type checking or native compilation.”
contract_inventory.acceptance: One actual lexical owner in GPU; all five and binary/comparison consumers use its selected function. Preserve existing source-role order, source declarations and canonical local error versus later SDK/compiler causes. Reject ambiguous visible duplicate declarations before a one-span rename could make invalid source valid.

contract_inventory.existing_contract: Pinned Naga line-comment terminators include LF/VT/FF/CR, NEL and Unicode line/paragraph separators; block comments nest. Existing source regex treats comment text as code.
contract_inventory.disposition: Source-backed mask semantics; implementation not yet reviewed
contract_inventory.required_wording: Describe masking comments and retaining source byte positions. Do not call this a complete WGSL lexer or Naga validator; only shared comment/line-end rules are established here.
contract_inventory.acceptance: Mask preserves byte length and valid source-span boundaries even for multibyte comment text. Naga comment-end characters U+000A–000D/U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 and nested block comments are covered by the actual implementation; no earlier whole-module parse or new numerical/identifier policy is inferred.

contract_inventory.existing_contract: Builders currently independently regex-replace a header, while Stencil neighborhood mode globally replaces raw Neighbors patterns. This can target comments and disagree with the signature capture.
contract_inventory.disposition: Shared-span rewrites required as part of same family
contract_inventory.required_wording: Say which selected source span changes: generated algorithms project resource-role parameters or lower neighborhood type syntax; G4 renames only the selected function identifier. Preserve original retained declarations rather than reconstructing their comments from masked text.
contract_inventory.acceptance: Selection and rewrite share the same original source/span authority. Preserve source outside intended argument/type/name edits, including actual body/comments/globals. Do not describe generated header projection as a byte-identical full header. Non-comment reserved neighborhood lowering must not rewrite commented text or coincidental substrings. Complete post-repair body proof is still required.

contract_inventory.existing_contract: Binary helper and comparison helper project first argument type. Binary regex does not validate equal argument/return types; comparison requires lexical bool return but does not check operand type agreement. Min/Max exact-name substring replacements differ from their parser whitespace acceptance.
contract_inventory.disposition: ComparisonSignature agreement/API boundary planned; no old parser compatibility forwarder
contract_inventory.required_wording: “Project the first comparison argument type and retain the selected source for identifier rewriting. Lexical admission does not validate operand agreement, function body or generated WGSL.” Binary direct API likewise documents first-parameter projection.
contract_inventory.acceptance: ComparisonSignature::parse/value_type/renamed_source consumes shared FunctionSource; remove old parse_compare_signature rather than preserve a forwarding path. Preserve comments/whitespace/body except actual declaration-name span. Ambiguous functions fail rather than selectively rename one into validity. All existing Min/Max callers migrate by the agreed contract.

contract_inventory.existing_contract: Public mutable code is parsed at construction/build/execute; source-aware caches include current code. ComputeShader parses/validates the generated program after bindings/source lowering, retaining actual causes.
contract_inventory.disposition: Keep lexical and native admissions separate
contract_inventory.required_wording: A signature/default definition is source-role metadata only; generated programs still undergo Naga parsing/validation and configured native creation. A successful lexical parse or rewrite is not a compiled pipeline or dispatch/native completion verdict.
contract_inventory.acceptance: Do not move Naga full-module validation earlier to reject supported pre-lowered Resource/Neighbors metadata. No cached signature stale against mutable code; current source participates in both parse and cache recipe. No universal native/browser/health/rollback claim.
